content.user_title: Audit SEO Performance and Prioritize Fixes
content.value_statement: SEO problems can hide across crawling, indexing, performance, content, and authority signals. This skill produces evidence-based findings, weighted scores, and prioritized recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Clarifies business goals, audit scope, target markets, devices, and available data before analysis.
Reviews crawlability, indexation, technical foundations, on-page optimization, content quality, and authority signals.
Calculates a weighted SEO Health Index with category scores and confidence-adjusted deductions.
Documents each issue with evidence, severity, confidence, impact, score deduction, and recommendation.
Groups recommendations into critical blockers, high-impact improvements, quick wins, and longer-term opportunities.
Tracks score changes against a previous audit and attributes changes to specific fixes.
limitations: Results depend on the site details, URLs, reports, and metrics supplied or made accessible.
The SEO Health Index measures readiness and does not guarantee rankings, traffic, or conversions.
Authority scoring is directional because external competition and algorithm changes are not fully measured.
The default workflow recommends fixes but does not implement them unless implementation is explicitly requested.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Traffic Decline
use_cases.description: Identify technical, indexation, and content issues after a migration, redesign, or unexpected organic traffic loss.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Store Improvements
use_cases.description: Audit templates, faceted navigation, product pages, internal links, and performance before planning development work.

use_cases.title: Review a Client Website
use_cases.description: Produce an evidence-based health score and prioritized recommendations for a consulting engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [page URL or supplied page data] for on-page SEO. State assumptions, findings, evidence, severity, and recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused assessment of one page.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Technical Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [site] for crawlability, indexation, mobile readiness, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals, architecture, and internal linking using the supplied evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs a structured technical SEO review.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Prioritized Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these audit exports: [data]. Calculate category scores, explain deductions, and group actions by urgency and expected score recovery.
prompt_templates.scenario: An SEO lead needs priorities tied to measurable findings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audit Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current audit with [previous audit]. Attribute score changes to verified fixes, identify unresolved critical issues, and update priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs evidence-based progress tracking.

output_examples.input: Audit the supplied category page and crawl report for indexation problems.
output: Issue: Key category page carries a noindex directive.
Evidence: The supplied crawl report records noindex on the category URL.
Recommendation: Remove the unintended directive and request validation after deployment.

output_examples.input: Summarize the supplied full-site audit and prioritize next actions.
output: Critical blocker: Important product pages are excluded from indexing.
High-impact improvement: Reduce slow server responses across product templates.
Quick win: Add missing sitemap references to robots.txt.

best_practices: Provide business goals, target markets, priority sections, recent site changes, and available data before requesting a full audit.
Supply repeatable evidence from multiple sources, including crawl exports, Search Console, analytics, logs, and performance reports.
Validate fixes in production and connect score changes to measured outcomes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a single tool score as proof of SEO health.
Do not assign deductions without evidence, severity, confidence, and a traceable finding.
Do not assume a higher health score guarantees better rankings or conversions.

faq.question: Does this skill implement SEO fixes?
faq.answer: It recommends fixes by default. Implementation happens only when explicitly requested and supported by the available tools and permissions.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide site type, goals, markets, audit scope, target devices, recent changes, known issues, and available reports.

faq.question: Can it audit one page?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the page URL or page data, target query, audience, and any relevant performance or indexing evidence.

faq.question: How is the SEO Health Index calculated?
faq.answer: Five categories receive weighted scores. Evidence-based deductions reflect issue severity and confidence, then combine into a score from zero to 100.

faq.question: Does a high score guarantee rankings?
faq.answer: No. The score measures SEO readiness. Competition, algorithm changes, authority, and user behavior can still affect organic performance.

faq.question: Can it compare audits over time?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide both audits so the skill can attribute score changes to validated fixes and identify unresolved issues.
